_doc: The fighting styles of docs/fighting_styles_design.md's rosters, written by hand from its tables (2026-10-09): each element's four (its canon one first) and Jeet Kune Do for every element. A class is element + style (20 classes); the Character Advancement window (scripts/ui/advancement/) shows a style's rail and levers and saves it with each loadout. Read through AdvancementData (styles, style, rail, levers).

Player text keeps each art's feel and drops real people's names and their quotes (the design doc's Jeet Kune Do line names a person and quotes him: its idea is kept, the words are not). No word from the show is used (tests/ring/test_player_words.gd).

state: canon (the element's own clips, today's look), animated (its own clips are built: Boxing, data/bending/style_poses.json), parked (clips made, then parked by the owner: Capoeira, 2026-10-09), coming (not made yet). Only canon and animated styles can be picked (data/ui/advancement.json switches.pickable_states).

levers: two +1 and two -1 of speed, power, reach, width, mobility, defence (the design's six levers; 10% each at the start, the soak retunes; nothing in play reads them yet). A style never changes a move's identity, never slows or hurts anyone's aim.

rail: the style's traits on the window's right edge, granted with the class (cost 0): stance (with its levers), jab string, signature, guard. chip names the key the trait sits on; move and mode its icon's move (empty: the element's own move on that chip: the jab on LMB, the guard on E). perfect: the small reward a perfect guard gives, when the style has one.
library: the style's clip library (tools/anim_author/install_style.gd); poses: its key in data/bending/style_poses.json. home_weapons: ids only (weapons are on hold, 2026-10-08).

hung_gar.label: Hung Gar
hung_gar.known: A low horse stance, tiger and crane hands.

rail.line: A low horse stance, tiger and crane hands.
Tiger-claw flicks; the Pop is a crane strike, straight up.
Fissure, grown: a double tiger palm driven into the deck, the widest crack and the slowest.
A two-hand catch from the horse stance.

karate.label: Karate
karate.known: Deep stances, straight strikes, one decisive blow.

rail.line: Deep stances, straight strikes, one decisive blow.
Snapping straight punches; the Pop is a reverse punch, flat and far.
Spike: a reverse punch drives it straighter and farther.
A sharp block and catch.
rail.perfect: On a perfect the throw comes back faster.

sumo.label: Sumo
sumo.known: Pushing and thrusting palms that force the foe out of the ring.

rail.line: Pushing and thrusting palms that force the foe out of the ring.
Open-hand thrusts; the Pop shoves level, best toward the open end.
Fissure: rapid thrusting palms into the deck, a wide crack built for ring-outs.
A belly-and-arms catch with the whole body.
Takedowns, lifts and slams.
Quick shots in close; the Pop is a lift.
Column and Slam: the Column launches higher, the Slam drives down harder.
A sprawl catch, low to the deck.

tai_chi.label: Tai Chi
tai_chi.known: Slow continuous circles, push hands, yielding.

rail.line: Slow continuous circles, push hands, yielding.
Circling splashes; the Pop rolls them up and over.
Wave: push hands, a wider and slower arc.
A yielding circle.
rail.perfect: A perfect Turn's return keeps curving.

aikido.label: Aikido
aikido.known: Turning the attacker's own momentum against him.

rail.line: Turning the attacker's own momentum against him.
Small entering strikes; the Pop is a turning throw.
Turn: a perfect sends the shot back farther.
A step off the line.
Throws from off-balancing.
Grips of water; the Pop is a hip-throw angle.
Geyser: the launch throws sideways at a set angle.
A grip and turn.
rail.perfect: A perfect readies your jab at once.

wing_chun.label: Wing Chun
wing_chun.known: The centreline, chain punches, sticky hands, trapping.

rail.line: The centreline, chain punches, sticky hands, trapping.
Chain punches: four small splashes before the Pop.
Splash and Lash: rapid centreline chains.
Sticky hands.
rail.perfect: A perfect Turn keeps you in range to string.

rail.line: Long-range kicks and extended strikes.
Long punches; the Pop is a flying kick.
High Kick: a long flying kick, the farthest fire arc.
An extended forearm parry.

boxing.label: Boxing
boxing.known: Jab, cross, hook and uppercut; head movement; footwork.

rail.line: Jab, cross, hook and uppercut; head movement; footwork.
A one-two and a hook: the hook is the Pop.
Punch and Embers: the fastest fire; the Fireball still grows, a little slower.
A slip.
rail.perfect: A perfect Parry readies a counter jab at once.

muay_thai.label: Muay Thai
muay_thai.known: Fists, elbows, knees and shins; the clinch; the push kick.

rail.line: Fists, elbows, knees and shins; the clinch; the push kick.
Elbows in close; the Pop is a clinch knee, straight up.
Kick: a shin roundhouse arc; grown, it becomes a straight push kick.
A shin check: the parry from a raised knee.
Punch-kick combinations and low kicks.
Punches that finish in a kick: the Pop is a round kick.
Kick: punch-kick flurries, a low fire wave along the floor.
A high guard parry.

baguazhang.label: Baguazhang
baguazhang.known: Circle walking, palm changes, spiralling evasion.

rail.line: Circle walking, palm changes, spiralling evasion.
Spiralling palms; the Pop is a turning palm.
Slip: the dash curves round the foe.
A turning palm.

capoeira.label: Capoeira
capoeira.known: Constant rocking footwork, acrobatics, spinning kicks.

rail.line: Constant rocking footwork, acrobatics, spinning kicks.
Swinging kicks; the Pop is a half-moon spin.
Gust: a full spinning crescent of wind.
A dodge in the rocking sway.
High, spinning and jumping kicks.
Fast snap kicks; the Pop is a jumping kick.
Leap: the close hit in the air becomes a jumping spin kick with more reach.
A lifted-knee wind guard.

drunken_boxing.label: Drunken Boxing
drunken_boxing.known: A drunkard's sway and deceptive feints.

rail.line: A drunkard's sway and deceptive feints.
Lurching swipes; the Pop is a falling strike.
Slip: shorter, but you recover faster.
A stumbling evasion.

jeet_kune_do.label: Jeet Kune Do
jeet_kune_do.known: Intercepting: stop-hits, economy of motion, the straight lead, no fixed form.

rail.line: Intercepting: stop-hits, economy of motion, the straight lead, no fixed form.
Straight leads; the Pop is a stop-kick.
The jab intercepts: a jab that lands while he holds a lock sets that lock back by its full cost (the rule every hit already has; it never slows him or his aim).
Your element's guard, from a narrower and faster stance.
